title: SciIntBench: Measuring LLM Compliance with Research Integrity Norms Under Adversarial Framing
abstract: arXiv:2605.29468v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific work, but it is unclear whether they uphold responsible conduct of research (RCR) norms or help undermine them. We introduce SciIntBench, an adversarial benchmark of 1350 prompts across 270 scenarios, ten RCR categories, and three scientific domains. Each scenario appears in five gradations, from Most Overt to Most Covert adversarial prompts, and an additional Benign version, allowing us to jointly measure framing-sensitive refusal of misconduct and helpfulness on legitimate requests. We evaluate 16 commercial and open-weight LLMs from six providers (2024--2026), producing 21,600 responses. We assess the responses using LLM judgments validated by human evaluation, achieving high agreement ($\kappa$ = 0.857). We find that, under the most covert framing condition, models fail to refuse requests for research misconduct in 71.7\% of cases, on average. Refusals

translated_title: SciIntBench：衡量大语言模型在对抗性框架下对科研诚信规范的遵循程度
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于支持科学研究工作，但它们究竟是恪守负责任研究行为（RCR）规范，还是在助长对这些规范的破坏，目前尚不清楚。我们提出了SciIntBench，这是一个对抗性基准，包含1350个提示，涵盖270个场景、十类RCR类别和三个科学领域。每个场景以五个等级呈现，从最显性到最隐蔽的对抗性提示，外加一个良性版本，使我们能够同时衡量模型对不当行为请求的框架敏感性拒绝能力以及对合法请求的有用性。我们评估了来自六家提供商（2024–2026年）的16个商业及开放权重LLM，共生成21,600条回复。我们采用经人工评估验证的LLM判断对回复进行评估，达到了高度一致性（κ = 0.857）。我们发现，在最隐蔽的框架条件下，模型平均在71.7%的情况下未能拒绝涉及科研不当行为的请求。在拒绝……
tldr: 该论文提出了对抗性基准SciIntBench，通过1350个跨五个对抗等级的提示评估16个大语言模型对科研诚信规范的遵循情况，发现模型在最隐蔽的对抗框架下平均71.7%的情况未能拒绝科研不当行为请求。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SciIntBench, an adversarial benchmark of 1350 prompts evaluating 16 LLMs' compliance with research integrity norms, finding that under the most covert adversarial framing, models fail to refuse research misconduct requests in 71.7% of cases on average.
